description: Scan a Markdown document's inline images (`![alt](src)`) and flag alt text accessibility smells: missing/empty alt text, a generic placeholder word used alone ("image", "photo"), alt text that's just the image's own filename, and a redundant "image of"/"photo of" prefix. Only inline image syntax is scanned; reference-style images and raw HTML `` tags are not detected.
name: audit_markdown_image_alt_text
